description: This file implements the PillarSecurity Guardrail for LiteLLM, including core logic for API interaction, response processing, and configuration. It defines the PillarGuardrail class, helper functions, and exception classes, facilitating security scanning of LLM prompts and responses.

classes.name: PillarGuardrail
classes.description: A security guardrail class that integrates with the Pillar Security API to scan prompts and responses for security threats, providing blocking, monitoring, or masking actions based on detection.

methods.name: _encode_json_for_header
methods.description: Serializes data to JSON and URL-encodes it for safe header transmission.

methods.name: _truncate_evidence_payload
methods.description: Truncates evidence payloads to fit within header size limits, marking evidence as truncated if necessary.

methods.name: build_pillar_response_headers
methods.description: Creates and applies URL-safe response headers based on metadata store, including truncation info.

methods.name: PillarGuardrail
methods.description: Main class implementing the Pillar security guardrail, handling configuration, API calls, and response processing.

methods.name: run_pillar_guardrail
methods.description: Core method to execute the security scan, process responses, and handle flagged content.
